content.summary: This guideline excerpt addresses electrolyte disturbances (hyperkalaemia, hyponatraemia, hypochloraemia) in heart failure (HF), treatment strategies (patiromer, spironolactone, hypertonic saline, water restriction, tolvaptan, acetazolamide), and a section on lung disease/sleep-disordered breathing with overlap of COPD and HF and guidance on pulmonary function testing and beta-blocker use. Key trial mentions include the DIAMOND RCT (patiromer) and ongoing multicentre study of acetazolamide.

electrolyte_disorders.hyperkalaemia: Discusses higher risk with RAAS inhibitor use; DIAMOND (NCT03888066) testing patiromer vs placebo in HFrEF patients with hyperkalaemia.
electrolyte_disorders.hyponatraemia: Defined as serum sodium <136 mmol/L; common in HF (up to 30% of admissions); severe cases may require hypertonic saline with controlled correction rates; pathogenesis often dilutional due to vasopressin; water restriction and vasopressin antagonists (e.g., tolvaptan) discussed.
electrolyte_disorders.hypochloraemia: Chloride <96 mmol/L is an independent predictor of mortality in acute and chronic HF; serum chloride may influence renin secretion and response to loop/thiazide diuretics; acetazolamide (carbonic anhydrase inhibitor) increases chloride reabsorption and is under investigation in decompensated HF.

lung_disease_section.title: 13.8 Lung disease, sleep-disordered breathing
points: COPD affects ~20% of patients with HF and complicates symptoms/outcomes.
Spirometry recommended as first diagnostic tool for suspected COPD; perform in stable, euvolemic patients.
Beta-blockers generally tolerated in COPD and are not absolute contraindication per GOLD and GINA; cardioselective agents (bisoprolol, metoprolol succinate, nebivolol) may be used with judgement.

notable_drugs_and_targets: tolvaptan (oral selective arginine vasopressin V2 receptor antagonist)
trials_and_evidence: DIAMOND (NCT03888066) — patiromer strategy in HFrEF with hyperkalaemia
Small randomized and observational studies of water restriction and hypertonic saline with loop diuretics for hyponatraemia
Multicentre randomized study testing acetazolamide in decompensated HF

genes.context: Tolvaptan described as an orally active selective arginine vasopressin V2 receptor antagonist for increasing serum sodium and diuresis in persistent hyponatraemia.

Associated Conditions: influence on response to loop or thiazide diuretics
genes.context: Text states serum chloride may have a direct role in the control of renin secretion and the response to loop or thiazide diuretics.
